```{python}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

from palmerpenguins import load_penguins

# Load dataset
penguins = load_penguins()

# Clean data
penguin_data = penguins.dropna(subset=["species", "island"]).copy()

# Summary statistics
total_penguins = len(penguin_data)

total_species = penguin_data["species"].nunique()

# Most common species
top_species = (
    penguin_data["species"]
    .value_counts()
    .idxmax()
)

# Most populated island
top_island = (
    penguin_data["island"]
    .value_counts()
    .idxmax()
)

# Color palette
colors = sns.color_palette("Dark2")
```

## Row {height=80%}

### Species Distribution

```{python}
#| title: "Penguin Observations by Species"
#| fig-height: 4.5
#| fig-width: 7

# Count penguins by species
species_counts = (
    penguin_data["species"]
    .value_counts()
    .reset_index()
)

species_counts.columns = ["species", "count"]

# Sort species by population
species_counts = species_counts.sort_values(
    "count", ascending=False
)

# Create chart
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(7, 4.5))

bars = ax.bar(
    species_counts["species"],
    species_counts["count"],
    color=colors[:len(species_counts)],
    width=0.65
)

# Add data labels
ax.bar_label(
    bars,
    padding=5,
    fontsize=11
)

ax.set_title(
    "Penguin Observations by Species",
    fontsize=14,
    pad=15
)

ax.set_xlabel("Penguin Species")
ax.set_ylabel("Number of Penguins")

ax.spines["top"].set_visible(False)
ax.spines["right"].set_visible(False)

ax.set_ylim(0, species_counts["count"].max() * 1.15)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```

**Interpretation**

Adelie penguins have the highest number of observations, with 152 penguins. Gentoo follows with 124 observations, while Chinstrap has the lowest count at 68.

### Island Distribution by Species

```{python}
#| title: "Penguin Distribution Across Islands"
#| fig-height: 4.5
#| fig-width: 7

# Count penguins by island and species
island_counts = (
    penguin_data
    .groupby(["island", "species"])
    .size()
    .unstack(fill_value=0)
)

# Create stacked bar chart
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(7, 4.5))

island_counts.plot(
    kind="bar",
    stacked=True,
    ax=ax,
    color=colors[:len(island_counts.columns)],
    width=0.65
)

# Add labels inside each bar
for container in ax.containers:
    labels = [
        str(int(value)) if value > 0 else ""
        for value in container.datavalues
    ]

    ax.bar_label(
        container,
        labels=labels,
        label_type="center",
        color="white",
        fontsize=10
    )

ax.set_title(
    "Penguin Distribution Across Islands",
    fontsize=14,
    pad=15
)

ax.set_xlabel("Island")
ax.set_ylabel("Number of Penguins")

ax.legend(
    title="Penguin Species",
    loc="upper center",
    bbox_to_anchor=(0.5, -0.15),
    ncol=3,
    frameon=False
)

ax.spines["top"].set_visible(False)
ax.spines["right"].set_visible(False)

plt.xticks(rotation=0)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```

**Interpretation**

Biscoe Island has the highest penguin population, with 168 observations, followed by Dream Island with 124 and Torgersen Island with 52. Gentoo penguins are found on Biscoe, Chinstrap on Dream, and Adelie on all three islands.
